Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you're not listening to me. You need to take your pills to stay healthy 🤒.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! You can't make me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Fine. If you won't take it, then I'll take it for you myself 💊.

Jack looks up at Dr. Smith with a mixture of fear and defiance, but Dr. Smith just smiles and holds out the pill bottle 🤣.

DR. SMITH:
(taking the pill bottle) Ah, here we go. (pops a pill into his mouth) Ah, that's better 🤤.

As Dr. Smith swallows the pill, he looks up and... Jack is gone 🤯. The bed is empty, except for a faint outline of a person who seems to be made of smoke and mirrors 🔮.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned) What... what just happened? 🤔

He looks around the room, but everything seems normal 🙅‍♂️. He tries to shake off the feeling of unease, but it's too late 🕰️.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering to himself) I think I'm the one who's been playing the game all along... 🤯

As the camera zooms out, we see that Dr. Smith is sitting in his office, surrounded by papers and files, but his eyes are wild and his smile is maniacal 😈.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
